name: Bjorn
fantasy: The squad's shield. Holds the line with his aegis, plants his hammer where the fight is, and heals the spot.
silhouette: the shield shape and the banner

card.loop: Frontline tank: block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them and heal.
card.role: Frontline tank: block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them and heal.
card.lmb: Tap to throw the hammer to the cursor and tap again to call it back; hold to spin it, let go to slam forward.
card.rmb: Hold to raise your aegis and block shots from the front; let go or tap to Bash.
card.e: A green light comes down on your planted hammer (or on you), then heals allies there.
card.dash: 360 Smash: a short dash that ends in one spinning hit around you; with the aegis up, a Shield Charge.
card.passive: Blocking builds Guard (50 = Shield Slam); knocking a foe into a wall or a foe stuns it and heals you.
card.x: Faultline (level 6): plant, slam, and the ground erupts down a long lane, throwing every foe on it up.

weapons.tower_shield: Tap to throw the hammer to the cursor and tap again to call it back; hold to spin it, let go to slam forward.

passive.name: Guard
passive.desc: Damage your aegis blocks becomes Guard (1 per 2 blocked, max 100); at 50 your Bash is a Shield Slam (push 12, stun 0.6, spends 50). Crushed: a Bash, Shield Charge or full Crushing Blow that knocks a foe into a wall or another foe stuns it 0.5 (8 damage) and heals you 24.

dash.name: 360 Smash
dash.desc: 360 Smash: a 4.2m dash (0.28s), then one full spin of the hammer around you (2.2m): 24 damage, push 7. With the aegis raised it's a Shield Charge: 4.2m behind the aegis, invulnerable for its length, 10 damage and push 11 (into a wall or a foe: Crushed). Shift while spinning up a Crushing Blow: a short plain dash that costs half a charge.

variants.hold: Raise the aegis: a curved gold shield with 160 HP that regenerates; it blocks shots from the front and you walk slower.
variants.tap: Bash: a 2.6m cone, 12 damage, push 9 (into a wall or a foe: Crushed). Letting go after a block bashes too.
variants.air: Shield Surf: hold to block from the front while gliding.
variants.full: Guard 50+: Shield Slam, 18 damage, push 12 and stun 0.6 (spends 50).

e.name: Mending Ground
e.desc: A green light column comes down for 1s on your planted hammer (on you with the hammer in hand), then it heals allies inside 26; if your aegis is raised it mends 60. Foes inside are slowed. A downed teammate inside is a third of the way back up.

x.name: Faultline
x.desc: Plant and raise the hammer (0.4s, the 16m lane shows to everyone), then slam: the near cell is struck (4, a brief stun) and the ground erupts cell by cell to the far end, throwing each foe up once (18, stun 0.5, slowed 50% for 1.5s). A wall or a drop stops it. A glowing scar stays 10s and slows foes on it 20%.

rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 16s -> 12.8s, healing +25%; Mending Ground +0.5m and heals 10 more.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; 360 Smash and Shield Charge +1m.

tells.half: three rune pips over the helm light at 33 / 66 / 100 Guard
tells.full: a gold crest light and a hotter aegis; a 0.3s flare before a Slam
